notes.title: Build 0.1.3 LIVE - Cooking & Interior campsites Update!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Survivors,

🔥 Build 0.1.3 is finally here and features a lot of back-end work and refactoring, preparing the way for deeper survival mechanics. New additions include 🏕️ interior campsites and 🍵 cooking enhancements for boiling water and brewing teas. The 🩸 blood infection affliction elevates medical gameplay and makes combat more dangerous than ever. 🎥 I've created a short overview video going into the details below—check it out!
[/p][previewyoutube="7JGPfpJPLTc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][list][*][p]Added Interior campsites that can now occur in certain ventilated points of interest around the map allowing you sleep indoors providing both a heat bonus and increase to condition & Fatigue recovery during sleep.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to boil water & cook tea's & Coffee for medicinal properties like stamina regen rate improvements, Condition recovery bonuses while sleeping & warmth recovery.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new cook-able items: Boiled water, Birch bark tea, Reishi tea, Coffee.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new spawnable items; Antiseptic, Coffee can, antibiotics.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Reishi mushrooms & new wilderness Reishi mushroom tree stump harvest-able item where you can find rare medicinal mushrooms in the wilderness.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new crafting resources: Reishi mushroom & Birch bark.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to recover fatigue & Temperature by consuming new items like coffee, tea's and sodas.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the new blood infection affliction.  Can now get an infection after a bleed.    Makes healing more challenging.  A warning stage can be treated with a disinfectant and a full infection can be treated with antibiotics or a special tea made of a certain type wild mushroom.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to consume food or drink items from your backpack inventory instead of having to quickslot them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new cooking SFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Vsync option to settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted sleep fatigue & condition recovery to be item based which incentivizes having better shelters or tents for a more restful night's sleep making it harder to heal up after damage leading to more careful strategies moving around the world.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the thirst drain rate slower by 25% and Hunger by 5% to balance with future updates allowing the player to stay in areas for longer without the need to constantly scavenge once supplies are gathered.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some consumables into multi use items allowing you to only partially consume an items nutrition or thirst content as needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted rifle decay per shot to be slightly more harsh & and did a balance pass on ammo from chests and bandits to be more scarce.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the chance to find water in some loot containers & added a chance for bandits to drop water.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted well's water regen amount per day to be more realistic and prevent over reliance on wells daily.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the calorie amount from venison by 2x for a much more filling meal.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the temperature drain rate speed when cold to damage threshold to be faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the tarp tent to now include a bedroll that's automatically used for interior campsites freeing up the player to not have to keep their default bedroll if a better tent is found.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the ability for alcohol to now be quickslotted for wound use.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed inventory items to be duplicated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where consuming a mushroom could unequip a melee weapon next time you crouched.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue if craft in a weapon state would exit back to unarmed animation mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Z key damaging the player.  A dev mode tool was left enabled on accident. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sometimes the quickslots bar would mis-calculate the state of an item requiring multiple clicks to perform an action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed melee with a ranged weapon to not use stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that sometimes shooting a ranged weapon would not use ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that would reset an armed animation state to unarmed after opening the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue allowing a quickbar slot item to be duplicated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that was preventing enemy AI detection from the proper distance after entering crouch state in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous other minor issues & Bugs as well.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Build 0.1.2.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

Today, we're pushing a hotfix to address a few bugs we discovered in the current build. We've also made it possible to close the inventory panel with the ESC key.

Thanks for your feedback and bug reports!


[*] Fixed an issue where unstuck button would break player inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue where if bandit loot container could not be reached a lockup would occur.
[*] Fixed an issue where well UI could stay stuck on the screen after leaving the well.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in construction site.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could rotate while entering or exiting the bed animation.
[*] Fixed an Issue where player could sometimes vault inside a loot container.
[*] Fixed an issue where swapping weapons in aim mode would lock the reticle to the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue when harvesting curtains could lock up the player running in place.
[*] Fixed an issue where harvest curtains would display an incorrect icon and override other icons with incorrect icon.
[*] Fixed an issue where if hurt during a weapon equip or swap the player could be put in a broken animation state without the weapon in hand and not able to attack.



[*] Adjusted Inventory panel so that esc key can now also be used to close panel.

notes.title: Build 0.1.2 LIVE - Melee Combat & Gear Screen Update!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

We're excited to release Build 0.1.2 to our wonderful backers.  It contains the new melee combat system, gear screen, wolf packs and many more quality of life features and polish to the game.  We hope you enjoy the new content and please read the full list of additions & features below!

[previewyoutube=uwLIBtW8yA0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for your amazing support! =)



[list]
[*] Added melee combat system & new weapons to the game allowing players to attack with fists, bats, shovels, axes, crowbars and knives to defend themselves.
[*] Added new melee system sfx & voice over to enhance  the experience.
[*] Added the gear screen to the inventory panel allowing players to store large weapons on the left & right shoulders to free up inventory space.
[*] Added a dive roll to the players toolset to evade attacks while being limited by stamina.
[*] Added deadly wolf packs in the wilderness which add a new threat to the world.
[*] Added a new deadly rifle bandit that can be found across various POI's on the map.
[*] Added a Stamina bar to show players their current & remaining stamina level.
[*] Added the ability to sleep in interior beds & couches for a more convenient way to recover fatigue without the need for a campfire to stay warm.
[*] Added a new unstuck button bound to the U key that can help reset and move you from a lockup or stuck issue in the game.
[*] Added a new item drop zone center screen to allow players to drag/drop items on the ground without having to use right click menu.
[*] Added new lootable low durability weapons to bandits.
[*] Added the ability to dissemble firearms to extract contained ammo & free up inventory space when finding multiples.  (This is the beginning of the infrastructure for weapon repairing.  Firearms will be able to be dissembled into weapon parts for repairing your own weapon at a workshop in the future.)
[*] Added new settings menu option with basic audio settings for now.
[*] Added the ability the harvest bushes with the axe which now gives 3 long sticks per harvest. A knife now grants 2 Long sticks.
[*] Added new POI locations: Police Station, Hunting shop & Survivalists shelter.
[*] Added 5 new consumable items & the new tarp tent for campsites.
[*] Added proper duel monitor support for people with multiple monitors.



[*] Fixed an issue where the player could fall through the ground when pathing to a container interaction.
[*] Fixed an issue to ensure the cursor stays locked to the primary monitor during gameplay, preventing disruptions.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the player to still move or interact after dead.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck during a door interaction and not reset back to idle.
[*] Fixed an issue with tear-down campsite before a active camp was set causing a lockup bug.
[*] Fixed an issue where campsite menu would show up exiting a campsite.
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing quickslot 2x would create an exploit allowing you to keep an item after dropping.
[*] Fixed an issue during container interaction if backpack was open as well cursor would disappear.
[*] Fixed an issue where weight was not removing upon consuming or dropping an item causing weight to spike up.
[*] Fixed an issue with inventory weight displaying multiple decimal points.
[*] Fixed an issue where main menu would not fade to black on start game if load time was too fast.
[*] Fixed an issue where consumable prop would get stuck in hands if two items were consumed too fast in a row.
[*] Fixed an issue where placing a campsite on a road debris mesh could break campsite and lock players up.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could still interact with a container if in inventory or crafting panel.
[*] Fixed an issue where the in-game main menu panels would not scale to screen size.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could not shoot the deer if crouched.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could not melee attack from crouched.  Can now attack while crouched.
[*] Fixed an issue where dying with a panel open could hinder player from respawning.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could lockup during vault interaction.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI could fall through ground on hit impact while equipping.  
[*] Fixed about a thousand other issues not mentioned here lol.


[*] Adjusted all panel menu's so that Esc key now exits a panel instead of showing menu.
[*] Adjusted starting player load out to no longer start with a pistol, ammo or bandage.
[*] Adjusted mushrooms to now stack up to 8 per stack to save inventory space.
[*] Adjusted Long & Short sticks to stack up to 8 per stack to save inventory space.
[*] Adjusted bandits to respond faster to sound detection & have faster turning rates.
[*] Adjusted crafting to allow esc key to cancel and fail the current crafting action if under attack or desire to stop.
[*] Adjusted the rotate item key to spacebar & added a new GUI tooltip when inventory is open.
[*] Adjusted weapon aim mode to not allow for interactions for a more clean experience during combat.
[*] Adjusted the Help & Controls Screen to include new additional controls.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 LIVE
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

It’s time for our latest game update! We’re excited to announce a complete overhaul of our loot system. Gone are the days of static items in non-interactive environments. Now, you can interact with the world in a much more immersive way—opening chests, car trunks, cabinets, dressers, trash piles, and more, which will be added over time. Full patch notes are below!

Thanks for your wonderful support!

[list]
[*] Added a complete loot system overhaul with lootable containers.
[*] Added drinking from wells to refill thirst for longer term survival.
[*] Added a 5th quickslot.
[*] Added wilderness mushrooms for optional food source.
[*] Added three additional small POI's on the map for first pass of map update.
[*] Added auto fail function to protect player from benig stuck or running in place.
[*] Added new sfx for all lootable container interacts.
[*] Added a take all button & Exit button for new loot container GUI.
[*] Added a new harvest plant animation for interacting with wilderness plants.

[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the player to lock up between two interact points near each other.
[*] Fixed a GUI bug with cutrains and log interact that could break button.
[*] Fixed a lockup bug that could occur when going to campsite with a torch lit.
[*] Fixed lots of other small bugs and glitches.

[*] Adjusted the GUI for interact to be smaller, cleaner and more contrast to see in all times of day.
[*] Adjusted bandages to heal less health & take much longer to heal.
[*] Adjusted enemy AI to drop much less ammo overall.
[*] Adjusted enemy AI group amounts & damage to be more balanced.
[*] Adjusted player melee attacks to not work if crouched.
[*] Adjusted the new item spawn balance for the overhaul.
[*] Adjusted deer positions to be a bit easier to find for players hunting.
[*] Adjusted the audio mix to be slightly louder.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0 LIVE
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

We're excited to announce the release of our latest patch! This update focuses on polishing features, fixing bugs, and cleaning up parts of the codebase to pave the way for new features coming soon. Be sure to check out the new build and read the patch notes below.

Thank you for your support!


[list]
[*] Added Pistol & Rifle crouch movement animations which now allow aiming & firing while crouched.
[*] Added Pistol & Rifle crouch equip animations so you can now equip/unequip or use items while crouched.
[*] Added item info boxes to crafting panel to make more clear what items are.
[*] Added a warm up value to the torch so it can now help warm you up in the cold while active.  Can be stacked with interior warmth values.
[*] Added a campsite UI indicator to help re-locate your existing campsite the next time you press C.
[*] Added new SFXs for bush harvest,  inventory actions, crafting, panels, hunger, thirst, fatigue warnings, and new set of nature ambient emitters that change depending on time of day to further bring the world to life.
[*] Added Outdoor & Indoor state audio logic to adjust audio levels when entering/exiting structures for better immersion.
[/list]


[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue with lighting that made early morning appear pitch black.  Now properly reflects morning sky changes before sun rises.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would not update the day/night ambient light changes after sleeping.
[*]     Fixed an issue that the player would not take damage on sleep.  Now applies both thirst and hunger damage per hour of sleep.
[*]     Fixed an issue where the player could not sleep while taking damage with hunger or thirst.  Now player can sleep while taking vital damage other than temperature which will wake the player up from sleep or not allow them to sleep until warmed up.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would cause player to get stuck on a mountain trying to harvest a bush.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would cause player to get stuck around the shed at farm.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would cause a player to get stuck at the truck at Warehouse.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would hide GUI hotkeys when leaving the campsite.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would prevent hunger vital from flashing when taking damage.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would cause a weapon to requip from inventory back to crouch.
[*]     Fixed an issue that could break sprinting if crouch too soon after exiting inventory.
[*]     Fixed an issue that could break the character controller movement IF exit campsite from sleeping animation too soon.
[*]     Fixed an issue that would break the mouse cursor from showing when wake up from sleep.
[*]     Fixed an issue related to campsite wrongly calling unequip weapon even if the player had no current weapon when entering and could lead to other bugs.
[/list]


[list]
[*]     Adjusted AI detection distance to be increased to stop events of player being able to shoot bandits before being spotted when in Line of sight.
[*]     Adjusted the Intractable script (Refactored) to improve interactions with resources and items to prefer items closest to the player and within the players facing field of view to allow easier access to picking the right item up. 
[*]     Adjusted Crafting panel item list to only include relevant items that are useful and ignore other inventory items.
[*]     Adjusted birch bark drops to a slightly higher density.
[*]     Adjusted amount of deer that can spawn to increase chances of finding one.
[*]     Adjusted the burn time amount for the wood log so its much more useful.
[*]     Adjusted homemade bandage icon to be smaller to make it easier to carry several in the inventory.
[*]     Adjusted unarmed sprint animation to better suit the unarmed movement set.
[*]     Adjusted the speed of bush harvest to be slightly faster.
[/list]

Known Issues:

- Can still lockup the player controller IF attempt to harvest a bush behind a rock so avoid that for now.  We will update this with a protection soon.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.9 LIVE
notes.content:
Hello survivors,

We've been hard at work behind the scenes fixing bugs and improving features for the demo. This marks the first of two patches to address all the core issues and improvements before moving on to the new features roadmap. Please see the changes below!

Thanks for your amazing support!


[list]
[*] Added birch bark tinder around the map near some birch trees.
[*] Added a hunt-able deer to map who can provide venison.
[*] Added additional Hunting rifle spawn locations for easier discovery.
[*] Added impact animations for IF shot during backpack idle.
[*] Added a grass tag so grass curb meshes now play footstep sfx.
[*] Added support for ultra wide monitors & 1440p with GUI Scaling.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause bandit AI to not hear gunshots.
[*] Fixed an issue where mouse was not locked to game screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with the menu blur transition effect being stuck on screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with harvest curtains position fix & SFX added
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get locked up harvesting a bush.
[*] Fixed an issue where a consumable item could be exploited to re-use in multiple quickslots.
[*] Fixed an issue where player would melee attack in crafting menu if equipped.
[*] Fixed an issue where campsite place shelter would remember items no longer in inventory.
[*] Fixed a game breaking bug where if crafting at campsite could break controller from exiting.
[*] Fixed an issue where eating an apple would not refill thirst value.
[*] Fixed an issue where an item would display the wrong icon above it.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Adjusted bush interaction so you can harvest with a torch or chemlight.
[*] Adjusted campfire fuel panel to now show current fuel available by default.
[*] Adjusted campsite light interaction to now show button to exit panel.
[*] Adjusted a previous placed campsite plot to now be removed and able to create a new instance.
[*] Adjusted Hide GUI hotkey to be disabled.
[*] Adjusted an issue with people dying in their sleep.  We now wake the player on taking damage while asleep.
[*] Adjusted player footsteps to be quieter when crouching & louder when sprinting.
[*] Adjusted the longstick icon to be different than short stick in crafting.
[*] Adjusted the enemy music to exclude peaceful AI such as deer.
[*] Adjusted enemies to no longer have auto aim and can miss sometimes.
[*] Adjusted GUI panels to swap instead of overlap to prevent lockups.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch 0.0.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated player spawn start locations to be more forgiving near roads.
[*] Removed night spawns occurrence for now
[*] Updated the default icon over bushes to a hand instead of a knife.
[*] Fixed a bug where player could not put up chemlight or swap from it.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing non-usable items to be quick-slotted.
[*] Fixed a bug with thirst vital not flashing when at 0 and player taking damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch 0.0.7
notes.content: Added Bandit Detected Voice over & fixed a bug in music system.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.5
notes.content: We've addressed a few interaction bugs & general clean up.
